_about: Census-people store for the 2007 federal election, the venue-proxy sibling of the voter-footprint demo lanes in data/booth-seifa-voter-YYYY.json (2016+; the AEC published no 'Votes by SA1' product before 2016, so a 2007 booth cannot be weighted by where its voters live). A booth's demo block is the 2006 Census Basic Community Profile counts of the collection district (CD) its VENUE sits in — the geo key of booth-seifa-2007.json — describing the venue's neighbourhood, never the booth's voters; persons is a real CD headcount, never a weighted pseudo-population. A division's row is the exact 2006-census sum over the CDs whole-allocated to its membership of the January 2007 national division set (the boundaries the 2007 election ran on) (cd-2006-ced-2006ed.json, derive-ced-era-alloc.py; whole-unit allocation by 6x6 grid majority with an LGA-sibling fallback), not an average of its booth rows. Shares mirror the GCP lanes: age renormalised over the 11 B01 bands (no age-not-stated column); language other-at-home over English-only + other; overseas-born over country-of-birth stated; university (bachelor and above) per the aged-15+ population less level-of-education-not-stated; blue-collar (technicians/trades + machinery operators/drivers + labourers of B44 the ANZSCO occupation major groups) over the eight stated occupation groups, inadequately-described and not-stated occupations out of the frame. The national row pools the division sums. A booth whose venue CD records no residents (commercial/industrial blocks; counts.boothsGeoEmpty) carries demo:null, as does one whose geo key is absent from the BCP (counts.boothsGeoMissing); inside a present block a lane is nulled rather than clamped when the BCP's small-area perturbation would put its share outside [0,1] (counts.boothsGeo-carrying rows only). Booth records carry geo of data/booth-seifa-2007.json; its venue-proxy caveats apply here too.

sourceUrls.bcp: ABS 2006 Census Basic Community Profile, collection districts (B01/B09/B12/B39_B/B44_B), abs.gov.au archive census06bcp.zip

deliveryBasis: venue-proxy per booth (collection district of the premises); exact era-division census sum per division
